mapper.sql: SELECT t.record_id, t.record_date, t.employee_id, t.employee_name, t.employee_no, t.org_id, t.shift_id, t.shift_name, t.clock_in, t.clock_out, t.clock_in_source, t.clock_out_source, t.late_minutes, t.early_minutes, t.attendance_status, t.overtime_hours, t.night_shift, t.remark, t.del_flag, t.create_by, t.create_time, t.update_by, t.update_time, d.dept_name AS org_name FROM biz_hr_attendance_record t LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON t.org_id = d.dept_id
mapper.delete: UPDATE biz_hr_attendance_record SET del_flag = '2' WHERE record_id = #{recordId}
